title: Work led by a deactivated technician stays visible under an inactive header
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A technician who leads at least one work order is then deactivated.
custom_steps:
1. Deactivate a technician who leads work.
  2. Switch to Tech View.
  3. Find that technician's group.
  4. Confirm the work is still shown and the header shows an inactive indicator.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Work led by a technician who has been deactivated stays visible under that technician.
  • A deactivated technician's group header is marked as inactive.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10045 — Story 2 Tech View. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S2-N2, S2-N3 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-N2: “Keep matching work visible under its deactivated lead technician.”
  • S2-N3: “Indicate deactivated technicians as inactive in group headers.”
